name: Tallinn Health University of Applied Sciences
summary: Tallinn health college; its Estonian-taught programmes need Estonian, and its one English programme, Assistant Pharmacist, had no 2026 intake.
notes: Assistant Pharmacist is a 3-year professional higher education programme in English; its how-to-apply page states admission is not available in 2026 and shows only a 2023 schedule.
Its other programmes are taught in Estonian and ask for Estonian at B2.
If the pharmacist programme reopens, tuition is €6,200 a year for everyone, with a specialty test and an online interview.
